name: Julia - Kämpfe für deine Träume!
overview: Julia Wilkins teaches physical education and German at the Humanistic Gymnasium in Munich-Haidhausen. For a woman in public service, she is very unconventional; not only is she an avid skydiver, but she also loves mountain biking and inline skating. She chose to become a teacher against her father’s wishes, which is why the two of them no longer speak to each other. But Julia has found a surrogate family.
